Authority of the Consuls/opponents-token: CR 614.1c/111.1: 'Creatures your opponents control enter tapped' applies to creature tokens too. Expected: the opponent's two Dragon Fodder Goblin tokens enter tapped (and its controller gains 2). Observed: the life trigger fires for both (22, correct) but both tokens enter untapped. Controls: the opponent's Grizzly Bears (a card) does enter tapped, and a Ninja token from the opponent's Kaito -2 also enters untapped, so the enters-tapped replacement skips tokens. Confidence high. Progenitus/countered-shuffles-into-libra: CR 702.16b/614.1a/701.6a: protection applies only to permanents and players, so Counterspell can target and counter the Progenitus spell; the countered card would go to the graveyard and is shuffled into its owner's library instead. Observed: Counterspell resolves (to the graveyard) but Progenitus stays on the stack and then resolves onto the battlefield. Control: the same Counterspell counters Grizzly Bears normally. Either protection is treated as working on the stack (the target deemed illegal on resolution) or the 'from anywhere' graveyard replacement aborts the counter. Confidence fairly high. New root, found by the FDN audit batch 6; no ticket yet.
